description:
Building a budget gaming PC in 2026 feels impossible with GPU and RAM prices climbing—but this combo is the workaround.
Refurb parts + DDR4 + Intel Arc gets you real 1440p AAA gaming without the DDR5 tax.

Rosewill Case: https://amzn.to/4r5ZiS3
16GB DDR4: https://ebay.us/wXdSgs

In this build, I’m putting together one of my favorite low-cost gaming PC combos so far—focused on maximum performance per dollar at 1440p. To dodge overpriced DDR5, I went with a refurbished MSI B660 DDR4 motherboard and paired it with an Intel Core i5-12600K (10 cores / 16 threads) for strong gaming + extra cores for modern titles.
